modifiedFiles.rationale: Expanded SealingCapability interface and validateCapability implementation to enforce CAD revision hash, canonical geometry hash, expiration (ttlMs), revocation check, single-use/limited-use (maxUses) replay protection, and domain authorization.
Updated computeHMACSealToken and sealEnvelope to pass authoritativeRevisionHash and authoritativeGeometryHash down to validateCapability for strict context and identity binding.

Updated runScenario to acquire a single-use execution SealingCapability bound to authoritativeRevisionHash and authoritativeGeometryHash from trusted issueSealingCapability, passing it to sealEnvelope.

Updated test to construct CfdToCoreBinding objects for generated CAD meshes, seal them via CanonicalDomainBindingEngine.sealBinding with CFD SealingCapabilities, and pass sealed bindings to Fvm3DNavierStokesSolver.solve.
Added comprehensive 15-scenario adversarial test battery (AUTH-01 through AUTH-15) verifying fail-closed authority boundaries.
